summary.headline: Horary Questions and Royal Omens
summary.text: Astrological catalogue entries 275–291 cover divination about stolen property, rumors, rulers and kingship, letters, meals, timing by years and months, and whether events or arrivals will occur. Authorities and manuscript references include Paul of Alexandria, Paris codex 2506, and codex 6.
